name: cryptoville
description: Pueblo digital de servicios entre personas con pago en garantía en Stellar

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cryptoville/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @cryptoville/shared" "npm run dev -w @cryptoville/api" "npm run dev -w @cryptoville/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cryptoville/shared && npm run build -w @cryptoville/api && npm run build -w @cryptoville/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cryptoville/shared && npm run test -w @cryptoville/shared && npm run test -w @cryptoville/api && npm run test -w @cryptoville/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cryptoville/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cryptoville/api && npm run typecheck -w @cryptoville/web
scripts.db:reset: supabase db reset --no-seed && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
